<style id="wp-custom-css">/* ===================== Container ===================== */
.news-ticker {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: auto;
	margin-top: -6px;  
  margin-bottom: 5px;        /* thoda upar-niche margin kam */
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  height: 40px;             /* height kam kiya */
  border: 2px solid #25D366; 
  box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fefefe, #e6f0e9, #fefefe); 
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* ===================== Ticker Text ===================== */
.ticker-text {
  position: absolute;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 14px;          /* thoda chhota font */
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #222;
  text-align: center;
  text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: tickerCycle 18s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform: scale(0.95);
  padding: 0 5px;           /* horizontal padding kam */
}

/* Message offsets */
.ticker-text:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; }
.ticker-text:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 6s; }
.ticker-text:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 12s; }

/* ===================== Highlight Text (WhatsApp style) ===================== */
.highlight {
  background-color: #25D366; 
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 1px 4px;        /* padding kam kiya */
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  text-decoration: none;

<style id="wp-custom-css">/* ===================== Container ===================== */
.news-ticker {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: auto;
	margin-top: -6px;  
  margin-bottom: 5px;        /* thoda upar-niche margin kam */
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  height: 40px;             /* height kam kiya */
  border: 2px solid #25D366; 
  box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fefefe, #e6f0e9, #fefefe); 
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* ===================== Ticker Text ===================== */
.ticker-text {
  position: absolute;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 14px;          /* thoda chhota font */
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #222;
  text-align: center;
  text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: tickerCycle 18s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform: scale(0.95);
  padding: 0 5px;           /* horizontal padding kam */
}

/* Message offsets */
.ticker-text:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; }
.ticker-text:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 6s; }
.ticker-text:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 12s; }

/* ===================== Highlight Text (WhatsApp style) ===================== */
.highlight {
  background-color: #25D366; 
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 1px 4px;        /* padding kam kiya */
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  text-decoration: none; 
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.highlight:hover {
  transform: scale(1.05);
  box-shadow: 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
}

/* ===================== Emoji Bounce ===================== */
.ticker-text::before { content: "📢"; margin-right: 5px; display: inline-block; animation: bounce 1s infinite; }
.ticker-text::after { content: "🔔"; margin-left: 5px; display: inline-block; animation: bounce 1s infinite; }

/* ===================== Animations ===================== */
@keyframes tickerCycle {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(100%) scale(0.9);}
  10% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0) scale(1);}
  40% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0) scale(1);}
  50% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-100%) scale(0.9);}
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-100%) scale(0.9);}
}

@keyframes bounce {
  0%,100% { transform: translateY(0);}
  50% { transform: translateY(-3px);} /* thoda kam bounce */
}

/* ===================== Hover Effects ===================== */
.news-ticker:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px #25D366;
  transform: scale(1.01);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.news-ticker:hover .ticker-text {
  animation-play-state: paused;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* ===================== Responsive ===================== */
@media (max-width: 500px) { .ticker-text { font-size: 12px; } }


/* ===================== Parent ===================== */
.button-wrapper {
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
	margin-top:8px;
}

/* ===================== Buttons ===================== */
.small-teer-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  background: #d6ffd6;
  color: #064d00;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-decoration: none;
  border: 1px solid #9ee89e;
  white-space: nowrap;
  margin: 0 0px;        /* 👈 GAP KAM */
}

/* Second Button */
.small-teer-btn.btn-alt {
  background: #d6e9ff;
  color: #0D47A1;
  border: 1px solid #8db8ff;
}

/* Mobile */
@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .small-teer-btn {
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    margin: 0 2px;      /* 👈 mobile me aur kam */
  }
}

.stg-strip {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 14px auto;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e8ffe8, #f5fff5, #ffffff);
  color: #0b7a20;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  flex-direction: row;
  font-family: "Rubik", sans-serif;
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(7,118,32,0.18);
}

/* Logo */
.stg-strip img {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 5px;
}

/* Text block */
.stg-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: start;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.stg-text .title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #0b7a20;
}

.stg-text .slogan {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #267d3c;
  margin-top:3px;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

@keyframes shineMove {
    0% { 
        left: -75%; 
    }
    100% { 
        left: 130%; 
    }
}

@keyframes spin {
    to {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
}

@keyframes flip-text {
    0% { 
        opacity: 1; 
        transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); 
    }
    25% { 
        opacity: 0; 
        transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-100%); 
    }
    50% { 
        opacity: 0; 
        transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(100%); 
    }
    75% { 
        opacity: 1; 
        transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); 
    }
    100% { 
        opacity: 1; 
        transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); 
    }
}

@keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% { 
        transform: scale(1); 
        opacity: 1; 
    }
    50% { 
        transform: scale(1.1); 
        opacity: .7; 
    }
}

@keyframes ripple {
    0% {
        transform: scale(0.6);
        opacity: 1;
    }
    100% {
        transform: scale(1.8);
        opacity: 0;
    }
}

@keyframes bounceMini {
    0%, 100% { 
        transform: translateY(0); 
    }
    50% { 
        transform: translateY(-4px); 
    }
}

@keyframes gradientSlide {
    0%, 100% { 
        background-position: 0 50%; 
    }
    50% { 
        background-position: 100% 50%; 
    }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
    from { 
        opacity: 0; 
    }
    to { 
        opacity: 1; 
    }
}

/* ===== Clean Branded Spinner ===== */

    0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
    100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* Flip Text Below Spinner */

    position: relative;
    height: 15px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

.spinner-text {
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #0D47A1;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    animation: flip-text 2s infinite;
}

/* Text Variation Timing */
.wait-text { animation-delay: 0s; }
.coming-soon-text { animation-delay: 1s; opacity: 0; }

/* Flip Effect */
@keyframes flip-text {
    0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) rotateX(90deg); }
    20% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) rotateX(0deg); }
    50% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) rotateX(-90deg); }
    100% { opacity: 0; }
}

.page-content > ol,

.page-content > ul > li,

.entry-content > ol > li:hover,
.post-content > ul > li:hover,
.post-content > ol > li:hover,
.page-content > ul > li:hover,

<style id="wp-custom-css">/* ===================== Container ===================== */
.news-ticker {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: auto;
	margin-top: -6px;  
  margin-bottom: 5px;        /* thoda upar-niche margin kam */
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  height: 40px;             /* height kam kiya */
  border: 2px solid #25D366; 
  box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  font-family: 'Rubik', sans-serif;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fefefe, #e6f0e9, #fefefe); 
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* ===================== Ticker Text ===================== */
.ticker-text {
  position: absolute;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 14px;          /* thoda chhota font */
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #222;
  text-align: center;
  text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: tickerCycle 18s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform: scale(0.95);
  padding: 0 5px;           /* horizontal padding kam */
}

/* Message offsets */
.ticker-text:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; }
.ticker-text:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 6s; }
.ticker-text:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 12s; }

/* ===================== Highlight Text (WhatsApp style) ===================== */
.highlight {
  background-color: #25D366; 
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 1px 4px;        /* padding kam kiya */
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  text-decoration: none; 
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.highlight:hover {
  transform: scale(1.05);
  box-shadow: 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
}

/* ===================== Emoji Bounce ===================== */
.ticker-text::before { content: "📢"; margin-right: 5px; display: inline-block; animation: bounce 1s infinite; }
.ticker-text::after { content: "🔔"; margin-left: 5px; display: inline-block; animation: bounce 1s infinite; }

/* ===================== Animations ===================== */
@keyframes tickerCycle {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(100%) scale(0.9);}
  10% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0) scale(1);}
  40% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0) scale(1);}
  50% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-100%) scale(0.9);}
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-100%) scale(0.9);}
}

@keyframes bounce {
  0%,100% { transform: translateY(0);}
  50% { transform: translateY(-3px);} /* thoda kam bounce */
}

/* ===================== Hover Effects ===================== */
.news-ticker:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px #25D366;
  transform: scale(1.01);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.news-ticker:hover .ticker-text {
  animation-play-state: paused;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* ===================== Responsive ===================== */
@media (max-width: 500px) { .ticker-text { font-size: 12px; } }


/* ===================== Parent ===================== */
.button-wrapper {
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
	margin-top:8px;
}

/* ===================== Buttons ===================== */
.small-teer-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  background: #d6ffd6;
  color: #064d00;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-decoration: none;
  border: 1px solid #9ee89e;
  white-space: nowrap;
  margin: 0 0px;        /* 👈 GAP KAM */
}

/* Second Button */
.small-teer-btn.btn-alt {
  background: #d6e9ff;
  color: #0D47A1;
  border: 1px solid #8db8ff;
}

/* Mobile */
@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .small-teer-btn {
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    margin: 0 2px;      /* 👈 mobile me aur kam */
  }
}

.stg-strip {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 14px auto;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e8ffe8, #f5fff5, #ffffff);
  color: #0b7a20;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  flex-direction: row;
  font-family: "Rubik", sans-serif;

.stg-strip img {

}

}

    25% {

    }
    50% {

        transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(100%); 
    }
    75% { 
        opacity: 1; 
        transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); 
    }
    100% {

    }
}

    }

    }
}

    50% {

    to {
